items.stem: 设函数 $f(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x^{2}y}y\mathrm{e}^{yt}dt$，则 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=$ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
由于 $f(x,y)$ 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}$。先对 $x$ 求偏导： 
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2xy^{2}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}y^{2}}
$$
 再对 $y$ 求偏导： 
$$
\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}=4xy\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}y^{2}}(1+x^{2}y^{2})
$$
 代入 $x=1, y=1$ 得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=8e$。

items.stem:
设
$$
u(x,y)
=\varphi(x+y)+\varphi(x-y)
+\int_{x-y}^{x+y}\psi(t)\,dt,
$$
其中 $\varphi$ 具有二阶导数，$\psi$ 具有一阶导数，则必有（ ）。
items.answer_explanation:
记
$$
p=x+y,\; q=x-y.
$$
由变上、下限积分求导公式，
$$
\begin{aligned}
u_x
&=\varphi'(p)+\varphi'(q)+\psi(p)-\psi(q),\\
u_y
&=\varphi'(p)-\varphi'(q)+\psi(p)+\psi(q).
\end{aligned}
$$
继续求导：
$$
\begin{aligned}
u_{xx}
&=\varphi''(p)+\varphi''(q)+\psi'(p)-\psi'(q),\\
u_{yy}
&=\varphi''(p)+\varphi''(q)+\psi'(p)-\psi'(q).
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}
=\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}.
$$
故选 B。

items.stem: 已知 $ f(t) $ 连续，令 $ F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{x-y} (x-y-t) f(t) \, dt $，则（）
items.option_a: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $
items.option_b: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $
items.option_c: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $
items.option_d: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ F(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}(x-y-t)f(t)dt=(x-y)\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt-\int_{0}^{x-y}tf(t)dt $，求偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}&=\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt+(x-y)f(x-y)-(x-y)f(x-y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}&=f(x-y)\\ \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}&=-\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt-(x-y)f(x-y)+(x-y)f(x-y)=-\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}&=f(x-y)\end{aligned} 
$$
因此，$ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y} $，且 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}} $。

items.stem: 设 $ F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{x-y} (x - y - t) e^{t} \, dt $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}} = \_\_\_\_\_\_ . $
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ F(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}(x-y-t)\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t=(x-y)\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-\int_{0}^{x-y}t\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t $，求偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}&=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\\ \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}&=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\end{aligned} 
$$
故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=2\mathrm{e}^{x-y} $。

document.stem_md: 设 $ F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{x-y} (x - y - t) e^{t} \, dt $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}} = \_\_\_\_\_\_ . $
document.explanation_md:
由 $ F(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}(x-y-t)\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t=(x-y)\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-\int_{0}^{x-y}t\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t $，求偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}&=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\\ \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}&=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\end{aligned} 
$$
故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=2\mathrm{e}^{x-y} $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ u(x,y) = f(xy) + \int_{0}^{x+y} f(x+y-t) \, dt $, $ v(x,y) = yf(x+y) + \int_{y-x}^{y} f(x+t) \, dt $, 其中函数 $ f(t) $ 具有一阶导数，则下列结论中，正确的是（）
items.option_a: 若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $.
items.option_b: 若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $.
items.option_c: 若 x ≠ y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} ≠ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $.
items.option_d: 若 x ≠ y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} ≠ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $.
items.answer_explanation:
首先化简 $ u(x,y) $ 和 $ v(x,y) $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}&u\left(x,y\right)\xlongequal{s=x+y-t}f(xy)+\int_{x+y}^{0}f(s)\mathrm{d}\left(-s\right)=f(xy)+\int_{0}^{x+y}f(s)\mathrm{d}s,\\&v\left(x,y\right)\xlongequal{s=x+t}yf(x+y)+\int_{y}^{x+y}f(s)\mathrm{d}s.\end{aligned} 
$$
分别计算 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y},\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x y)+f(x+y), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=x f^{\prime}(x y)+f(x+y), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x+y)+f(x+y). 
$$
若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。因此，应选 A。
下面说明选项 B、C、D 不正确。由于当 x = y 时，不能保证 $ f'(xy) = f'(x + y) $，故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $ 不一定相等。选项 B 不正确。取 $ f \equiv 0 $，可知 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0 $。选项 C 和 D 不正确。

$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x+y)+f(x+y). 
$$
若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。因此，应选 A。
下面说明选项 B、C、D 不正确。由于当 x = y 时，不能保证 $ f'(xy) = f'(x + y) $，故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $ 不一定相等。选项 B 不正确。取 $ f \equiv 0 $，可知 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0 $。选项 C 和 D 不正确。

items.stem: 设 $ z=\frac{2x}{x^{2}-y^{2}} $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}\right|_{(2,1)}= $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ z=\frac{1}{x+y}-\frac{1}{y-x} $，得 $ z=\frac{x-y+x+y}{(x+y)(x-y)}=\frac{2x}{x^{2}-y^{2}} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}=\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(x+y\right)^{n+1}}-\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(y-x\right)^{n+1}},\quad \frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}\bigg|_{(2,1)}=\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{3^{n+1}}-\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(-1\right)^{n+1}}=\left[1+\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}}{3^{n+1}}\right]n!. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ z = f\left(\ln x + \frac{1}{y}\right) $，其中函数 $ f(u) $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___
items.answer_explanation:
利用链式法则，
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)\cdot\frac{1}{x},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\right). 
$$
因此，
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)-f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)=0. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ z=\frac{y}{x}f(xy) $，其中函数 $ f $ 可微，则 $ \frac{x}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}= $（）
items.answer_explanation:
（法一）用链式法则分别求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot y=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy), 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot x=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+y f'(xy). 
$$
因此，
$$
 \frac{x}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy)+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy)=2yf'(xy). 
$$
应选 A。
（法二）利用全微分形式的不变性。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}z&=f(xy)\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+\frac{y}{x}\mathrm{d}[f(xy)]\\&=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)\mathrm{d}x+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)\mathrm{d}y+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot y\mathrm{d}x+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\left[\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy)-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)\right]\mathrm{d}x+\left[yf'(xy)+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)\right]\mathrm{d}y.\end{aligned} 
$$
因此，
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy),\qquad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy). 
$$
其余同法一。

items.stem: 设 $ f(u) $ 可导, $ z = xy f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $, 若 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = y^2 (\ln y - \ln x) $, 则（）
items.answer_explanation:
分别求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $. 利用链式法则, 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+x y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)=y f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-\frac{y^{2}}{x}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+x y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\cdot\frac{1}{x}=x f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). 
$$
 于是, $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). $ 与 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = y^{2} (\ln y - \ln x) = y^{2} \ln \frac{y}{x} $ 比较可得， $ f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \frac{y}{2x} \ln \frac{y}{x} $. 从而， $ f(u) = \frac{1}{2} u \ln u $， $ f'(u) = \frac{1}{2} (\ln u + 1) $. 因此， $ f(1)=0,f'(1)=\frac{1}{2} $. 应选 B.

 z_{_{y}}^{\prime}=\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^{^{2}}+y^{^{2}}}}f\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)+\frac{\sqrt{x^{^{2}}+y^{^{2}}}}{x}f^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big), 
$$
 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，则 
$$
 \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)=\frac{2y^{2}}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}, 
$$
 
$$
 f\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)=\frac{2y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}=\frac{2\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)^{2}}{1+\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 f(x)=\frac{2x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}. 
$$
 则 $ f(1)=1, f'(1)=1 $ ，故应选(D).

items.stem: 已知函数 $ f(u) $ 可导，二元函数 $ z(x, y) = f(xy) f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $ 满足 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 2xy e^{xy + \frac{y}{x}} $，则下列关于函数 $ f(u) $ 的说法中，正确的是（）
items.option_a: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 是凸曲线.
items.option_b: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 是凹曲线.
items.option_c: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 存在拐点.
items.option_d: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 存在渐近线.
items.answer_explanation:
首先计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $. 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x y)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)f(x y), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x f^{\prime}(x y)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+\frac{1}{x}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)f(x y). 
$$
 于是 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2xyf^{\prime}(xy)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). 
$$
 从而当 $ x\neq0,y\neq0 $时，可得令 $ u = xy, v = \frac{y}{x} $，则 $ f'(u)f(v) = e^{u+v} $。由此可得 
$$
 \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\frac{e^{v}}{f(v)}. 
$$
 由(1)式可得，固定 $ v=v_{0} $，对任意u，均有 $ \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\frac{e^{v_{0}}}{f(v_{0})} $。从而 $ \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\lambda $，其中 $ \lambda $为常数。于是， $ f^{\prime}(u)=\lambda e^{u} $， $ f(u)=\lambda e^{u}+C $。另一方面，由(1)式可得 
$$
 \frac{e^{v}}{f(v)}=\lambda,\quad 即 f(v)=\frac{1}{\lambda}e^{v}. 
$$
 比较 $ f(u) $与 $ f(v) $的表达式可得， $ C=0,\lambda=\frac{1}{\lambda} $. 因此， $ \lambda=\pm1,f(u)=\pm\mathrm{e}^{u} $ 由于根据题干条件无法确定 $ f(u) $的符号，故选项A和B均不正确。由于 $ y = e^{u} $ 为凹曲线， $ y = -e^{u} $ 为凸曲线，故它们均没有拐点，选项 C 不正确。由于曲线 $ y = e^{u} $ 和 $ y = -e^{u} $ 均存在水平渐近线 y = 0，故选项 D 正确。综上所述，应选D.

items.stem:
设
$$
z=\frac1x f(xy)+y\varphi(x+y),
$$
其中 $f,\varphi$ 具有二阶连续导数。求
$$
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\,\partial y}.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
在 $x\ne0$ 的定义域内，$z$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，混合偏导数可以交换求导次序。先对 $y$ 求偏导，可以避免产生多余的分式项。

第一步：对 $y$ 求偏导。

求导时将 $x$ 视为常数，得
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_y
&=\frac1x f'(xy)\cdot x
+\varphi(x+y)+y\varphi'(x+y)\\
&=f'(xy)+\varphi(x+y)+y\varphi'(x+y).
\end{aligned}
$$

第二步：对上式再对 $x$ 求偏导。

此时将 $y$ 视为常数，得到
$$
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\,\partial y}
=yf''(xy)+\varphi'(x+y)+y\varphi''(x+y).
$$

items.stem:
设 $f(u)$ 具有二阶连续导数，且
$$
g(x,y)=f\left(\frac yx\right)+yf\left(\frac xy\right).
$$
求
$$
x^2\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial x^2}
-y^2\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial y^2}.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
令
$$
u=\frac yx,
\;
v=\frac xy.
$$
对第一项 $f(u)$ 求二阶偏导，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}f(u)
&=\frac{2u}{x^2}f'(u)+\frac{u^2}{x^2}f''(u),\\
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial y^2}f(u)
&=\frac1{x^2}f''(u).
\end{aligned}
$$
对第二项 $yf(v)$ 求二阶偏导，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}[yf(v)]
&=\frac1y f''(v),\\
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial y^2}[yf(v)]
&=\frac{v^2}{y}f''(v).
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
x^2g_{xx}-y^2g_{yy}
&=2u f'(u)+u^2f''(u)-\frac{y^2}{x^2}f''(u)\\
&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}+\frac{x^2}{y}f''(v)-yv^2f''(v)\\
&=2u f'(u)\\
&=\frac{2y}{x}f'\left(\frac yx\right),
\end{aligned}
$$
其中使用了 $u^2=y^2/x^2$ 与 $yv^2=x^2/y$。

items.answer_explanation: 由 $ z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y) $ 得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f+x f^{\prime}+y g^{\prime},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-x f^{\prime}+g+y g^{\prime} $，所以 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=f^{\prime}+f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=2f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $， $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=x f^{\prime \prime}+g^{\prime}+g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=x f^{\prime \prime}+2g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $，故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=2f^{\prime}-2g^{\prime}=2(f^{\prime}-g^{\prime}) $，应选(A)。

items.answer_explanation:
函数
$$u=yf\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)+xg\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$$是关于 $x,y$ 的一阶齐次函数。由欧拉公式

items.stem: 设 $ f, g $ 为连续可微函数， $ u = f(x, xy) $， $ v = g(x + xy) $，求 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $。
items.answer_explanation:
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial f(x, xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} + y f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial g(x+xy)}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy) \cdot \frac{\partial(x+xy)}{\partial x} = (1+y)g^{\prime}(x+xy). 
$$
 故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy)(1 + y)(f_{1}^{\prime} + yf_{2}^{\prime}) $。

$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial g(x+xy)}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy) \cdot \frac{\partial(x+xy)}{\partial x} = (1+y)g^{\prime}(x+xy).

items.stem: 设 $ z = f\left(xy, \frac{x}{y}\right) + g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 $ f, g $ 均可微，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
本题考查抽象复合函数求偏导，使用链式法则。将 $ y $ 视为常数，对 $ x $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y} + g^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) = y f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{f_{2}^{\prime}}{y} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime}. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 为二元可微函数， $ z = f(x^{y}, y^{x}) $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
根据链式法则，对 $ x $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(x^{y})}{\partial x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(y^{x})}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y x^{y-1} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot y^{x} \ln y. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 是二元可微函数， $ z = f\left(\frac{y}{x}, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
首先计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right). 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) - y\left(\frac{1}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) = -\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} = 2\left(-\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$

items.stem: 已知函数 $ f(u,v) $ 可微， $ z(x,y) = f(x + y, y - x) - f(xy, 2 - x) $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = $ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
根据链式法则： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - y f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - x f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 于是， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + (x-y)f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 代入点 $ (2,2) $： 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) + f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) = -f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0). 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f $ 与 $ g $ 均可微， $ z = f[xy, \ln x + g(xy)] $，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ( )。
items.answer_explanation:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(\frac{1}{x} + g^{\prime} \cdot y\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot x + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot g^{\prime} \cdot x. 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left[y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{x} + y g^{\prime}\right)\right] - y\left[x f_{1}^{\prime} + x f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime}\right] = x y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} + x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} - x y f_{1}^{\prime} - x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} = f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数， $ z = f(xy, x + y) $。若 $ \left. \mathrm{d}z \right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6 \mathrm{d}x + 5 \mathrm{d}y $，则 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6, 5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6, 5) = $ ___。
items.answer_explanation:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y). 
$$
 由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}z\right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6\mathrm{d}x + 5\mathrm{d}y $，得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=6 $， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=5 $。代入得方程组： 
$$
 \begin{cases} 3f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 6, \\ 2f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 5. \end{cases} 
$$
 解得 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5)=1 $， $ f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5)=3 $。因此， $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 4 $。

items.stem: 设 $ z = f(2x - y) + g(x, xy) $，其中函数 $ f(t) $ 二阶可导， $ g(u, v) $ 具有连续二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
items.answer_explanation:
首先计算一阶偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f^{\prime}(2x - y) \cdot 2 + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot y = 2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 然后对 $ y $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left[2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy)\right] = 2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) \cdot (-1) + \left[g_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + y \left[g_{21}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 由于 $ g $ 具有连续二阶偏导数， $ g_{12}^{\prime\prime} = g_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，最终结果为： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ z = f(2x - y, y \sin x) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
items.correct_answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u^2}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}+y\sin x\cos x\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}+\cos x\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}$，其中各偏导均在 $(u,v)=(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。
items.answer_explanation:
令 $u=2x-y$，$v=y\sin x$，则 $z=f(u,v)$。先对 $x$ 求偏导：
$$
z_x=2f_u+y\cos x\,f_v.
$$
再对 $y$ 求偏导，利用 $u_y=-1$、$v_y=\sin x$ 以及 $f_{uv}=f_{vu}$，得
$$
\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2f_{uu}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)f_{uv}+y\sin x\cos x\,f_{vv}+\cos x\,f_v.
$$
这里 $f_u,f_v,f_{uu},f_{uv},f_{vv}$ 均表示 $f$ 对相应变量的偏导，并在 $(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。

items.stem:
设
$$
z=f\left(xy,\frac{x}{y}\right)+g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right),
$$
其中 $f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$g$ 具有二阶连续导数，求
$$
\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
按微分算子的顺序，
$$
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\,\partial y}
=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}
\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right),
$$
先对 $y$ 求偏导，再对 $x$ 求偏导。

记
$$
u=xy,\; v=\frac{x}{y},\; w=\frac{y}{x}.
$$
下文 $f$ 的各偏导数均在 $(u,v)$ 处取值，$g',g''$ 均在 $w$ 处取值；$f''_{ij}$ 表示先对第 $i$ 个自变量、再对第 $j$ 个自变量求偏导。

第一步：对 $y$ 求偏导。

由
$$
u_y=x,\; v_y=-\frac{x}{y^2},\; w_y=\frac1x,
$$
得
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}
=xf'_1-\frac{x}{y^2}f'_2+\frac1xg'.
$$

第二步：对 $x$ 求偏导。

此时
$$
u_x=y,\; v_x=\frac1y,\; w_x=-\frac{y}{x^2}.
$$
利用乘积求导法则与链式法则，逐项计算：
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(xf'_1)
&=f'_1+x\left(yf''_{11}+\frac1y f''_{12}\right)\\
&=f'_1+xyf''_{11}+\frac{x}{y}f''_{12}.
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(-\frac{x}{y^2}f'_2\right)
&=-\frac{f'_2}{y^2}
-\frac{x}{y^2}\left(yf''_{21}+\frac1y f''_{22}\right)\\
&=-\frac{f'_2}{y^2}
-\frac{x}{y}f''_{21}-\frac{x}{y^3}f''_{22}.
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac1xg'\right)
=-\frac{g'}{x^2}-\frac{y}{x^3}g''.
$$

第三步：合并混合偏导项。

由于 $f$ 的二阶偏导数连续，
$$
f''_{12}=f''_{21}.
$$
合并以上各式，混合偏导项相消，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\,\partial y}
={}&f'_1-\frac{f'_2}{y^2}\\
&+xyf''_{11}-\frac{x}{y^3}f''_{22}\\
&-\frac{g'}{x^2}-\frac{y}{x^3}g''.
\end{aligned}
$$

items.stem:
设
$$
z=f(x^2-y^2,e^{xy}),
$$
其中 $f$ 具有连续二阶偏导数，求
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},
\;
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},
\;
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
令
$$
u=x^2-y^2,
\;
v=e^{xy}.
$$
则
$$
u_x=2x,
\;
u_y=-2y,
\;
v_x=ye^{xy},
\;
v_y=xe^{xy}.
$$
由复合函数求导法则，
$$
z_x=2xf_u+ye^{xy}f_v,
$$
$$
z_y=-2yf_u+xe^{xy}f_v.
$$
再对 $z_x$ 关于 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{xy}
&=2x(f_{uu}u_y+f_{uv}v_y)\\
&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}+(1+xy)e^{xy}f_v
+ye^{xy}(f_{vu}u_y+f_{vv}v_y)\\
&=-4xyf_{uu}
+2(x^2-y^2)e^{xy}f_{uv}\\
&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}+xye^{2xy}f_{vv}
+(1+xy)e^{xy}f_v.
\end{aligned}
$$
以上所有 $f$ 的偏导数均在
$$
(u,v)=(x^2-y^2,e^{xy})
$$
处取值。

设函数 $f(u,v)$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$z=f(x,xy)$，则
$$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\underline{\hspace{3em}}.$$
items.answer_explanation:
第一步：求一阶偏导数。

记 $f_i$ 为 $f$ 对第 $i$ 个自变量的一阶偏导数，$f_{ij}$ 为对应二阶偏导数。以下各偏导数均在 $(x,xy)$ 处取值。由链式法则，
$$z_x=f_1+yf_2.$$

第二步：对 $y$ 再求导。

$$\frac{\partial f_1}{\partial y}=xf_{12},$$
$$\frac{\partial(yf_2)}{\partial y}=f_2+xyf_{22}.$$
相加得到
$$z_{xy}=xf_{12}+f_2+xyf_{22}.$$
注意对 $yf_2$ 求导时必须使用乘积法则，不能漏掉 $f_2$。

items.stem: 设 $z=f(x+y,x-y,xy)$，其中 $f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $dz$ 与 $\dfrac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}$。
items.correct_answer:
$$
dz=(f_1+f_2+yf_3)\,dx+(f_1-f_2+xf_3)\,dy.
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{xy}={}&f_{11}-f_{22}+(x+y)f_{13}\\
&+(x-y)f_{23}+xyf_{33}+f_3.
\end{aligned}
$$
各偏导数均在 $(x+y,x-y,xy)$ 处取值。
items.answer_explanation:
第一步：引入中间变量并求全微分。

令 $u=x+y$、$v=x-y$、$w=xy$。用 $f_1,f_2,f_3$ 表示 $f$ 对三个自变量的一阶偏导数，$f_{ij}$ 表示对应的二阶偏导数。以下各偏导数均在 $(u,v,w)=(x+y,x-y,xy)$ 处取值。

由链式法则，
$$
\begin{aligned}
dz&=f_1\,du+f_2\,dv+f_3\,dw\\
&=f_1(dx+dy)+f_2(dx-dy)+f_3(y\,dx+x\,dy).
\end{aligned}
$$
整理得
$$
dz=(f_1+f_2+yf_3)\,dx+(f_1-f_2+xf_3)\,dy.
$$

第二步：对 $z_x$ 关于 $y$ 求导。

由 $z_x=f_1+f_2+yf_3$，分别计算
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial f_1}{\partial y}&=f_{11}-f_{12}+xf_{13},\\
\frac{\partial f_2}{\partial y}&=f_{21}-f_{22}+xf_{23},\\
\frac{\partial(yf_3)}{\partial y}
&=f_3+y(f_{31}-f_{32}+xf_{33}).
\end{aligned}
$$
注意最后一式中的 $y$ 也要参与求导，不能漏掉 $f_3$。

第三步：利用混合偏导数相等化简。

由于二阶偏导数连续，有 $f_{12}=f_{21}$、$f_{13}=f_{31}$、$f_{23}=f_{32}$，故
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}
={}&f_{11}-f_{22}+(x+y)f_{13}\\
&+(x-y)f_{23}+xyf_{33}+f_3.
\end{aligned}
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = f(xy, yg(x)) $，其中函数 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x) $ 可导，且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 1 $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{\substack{x=1 \\ y=1}} $。
items.answer_explanation: 由链式法则，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot yg^{\prime}(x) = y f_{1}^{\prime} + yg^{\prime}(x) f_{2}^{\prime} $。进而，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y} \left[ y f_{1}^{\prime} + yg^{\prime}(x) f_{2}^{\prime} \right] = f_{1}^{\prime} + g^{\prime}(x) f_{2}^{\prime} + y \left[ x f_{11}^{\prime \prime} + g(x) f_{12}^{\prime \prime} + xg^{\prime}(x) f_{21}^{\prime \prime} + g(x)g^{\prime}(x) f_{22}^{\prime \prime} \right] $。由 $ g(x) $ 可导且在 $ x=1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1)=1 $，知 $ g^{\prime}(1)=0 $。将 $ x=1, y=1, g(1)=1, g^{\prime}(1)=0 $ 代入，得 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{\substack{x=1 \\ y=1}} = f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1) + f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(1,1) + f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(1,1) $。

items.stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} = 1 $，又 $ g(x,y) = f\left[ xy, \frac{1}{2}(x^{2} - y^{2}) \right] $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $。
items.answer_explanation: 令 $ u = xy, v = \frac{1}{2}(x^{2} - y^{2}) $。先求一阶偏导：$ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = y \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + x \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $，$ \frac{\partial g}{\partial y} = x \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} - y \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $。再求二阶偏导：$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} = y^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + 2xy \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u \partial v} + x^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $，$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} = x^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} - 2xy \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u \partial v} + y^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} - \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $。两式相加得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} = (x^{2}+y^{2}) \left( \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} \right) $。代入条件 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} = 1 $，得结果为 $ x^{2} + y^{2} $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(x+y,x-y) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
items.answer_explanation:
令 $ u=x+y, v=x-y $，则 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(u,v) $。

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-(f'_u+f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}+2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}=1-(f''_{uu}-f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-(f'_u-f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}-2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

将以上三式相加得：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1-3f''_{uu}-f''_{vv} 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ y=f(e^{x},\cos x) $，求 $ \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=0},\left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0} $.
items.answer_explanation:
令 $ u=e^{x}, v=\cos x $，则 $ y=f(u,v) $。

$$
 \frac{dy}{dx}=f'_u\cdot e^{x}+f'_v\cdot(-\sin x) 
$$

代入 $ x=0 $，得 $ u=1, v=1 $，故 $ \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=0}=f'_u(1,1) $。

$$
 \frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}=(f''_{uu}e^{x}+f''_{uv}(-\sin x))e^{x}+f'_u e^{x}+(f''_{vu}e^{x}+f''_{vv}(-\sin x))(-\sin x)+f'_v(-\cos x) 
$$

代入 $ x=0 $，得 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=f''_{uu}(1,1)+f'_u(1,1)-f'_v(1,1) $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，且 $ \left. \mathrm{d}f \right|_{(1,1)} = 3 \mathrm{d}u + 4 \mathrm{d}v $. 令 $ y = f(\cos x, 1+x^{2}) $，则 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}= $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}f\right|_{(1,1)}=3\mathrm{d}u+4\mathrm{d}v $，知 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}=3,\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=4 $。

因为 $ y = f(\cos x, 1 + x^{2}) $，所以

$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot(2x) 
$$

$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=&-\cos x\cdot\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}-\sin x\cdot\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot(2x)\right]\\&+2\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+2x\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot(2x)\right].\end{aligned} 
$$

将 $ x=0 $ 代入，得 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=-\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}+2\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=-3+8=5 $。

items.stem:
已知函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，且函数 $ g(x, y) = f(2x + y, 3x - y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}-6\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1 $。
(Ⅰ) 求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v} $；
（Ⅱ）若 $ \frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u\mathrm{e}^{-u},\quad f(0,v)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $，求 $ f(u,v) $的表达式。
items.answer_explanation:
（Ⅰ）记 $ u=2x+y,\quad v=3x-y $，由 $ g(x,y)=f(2x+y,3x-y) $求导得

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+3\frac{\partial f}{\partial v},\quad \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}-\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}=4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+12\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+9\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}=2\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}-3\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}-6\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1 $，并整理得 $ 25\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=1 $，即 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=\frac{1}{25} $。

（Ⅱ）由（Ⅰ）知 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}=\frac{1}{25} $，所以

$$
 \frac{\partial f}{\partial u}=\frac{1}{25}v+C(u),\quad f(u,\quad v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+\int C(u)\mathrm{d}u+C_{0}(v) 
$$

记 $ f(u,v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+h_{1}(u)+h_{2}(v) $。

由题设 $ \frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $可知 $ h_{1}^{\prime}(u)=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $。

由题设 $ f(0, v)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $ 可知 $ h_{2}(v)+h_{1}(0)=\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-1 $。

又由 $ h_{1}^{\prime}(u)=u\mathrm{e}^{-u} $ 得 $ h_{1}(u)-h_{1}(0)=-(u+1)\mathrm{e}^{-u}+1 $。

所以 $ h_{1}(u)+h_{2}(v)=-(u+1)\mathrm{e}^{-u}+\frac{1}{50}v^{2} $。

综上可知， $ f(u,v)=\frac{1}{25}uv+\frac{1}{50}v^{2}-(u+1)e^{-u} $。

items.answer_explanation:
（Ⅰ）先将函数关系改写为新变量的形式

由 $u=x+y$、$v=x-y$，解得

$$
x=\frac{u+v}{2}, y=\frac{u-v}{2}.
$$

因此

$$
xy=\frac{u^2-v^2}{4}.
$$

记

$$
Z(u,v)=z\left(\frac{u+v}{2},\frac{u-v}{2}\right),
$$

则

$$
w(u,v)=\frac{u^2-v^2}{4}-Z(u,v).
$$

固定 $v$ 对 $u$ 求导。因为 $x_u=y_u=1/2$，且 $x_{uu}=y_{uu}=0$，链式法则直接给出

$$
Z_{uu}=\frac14z_{xx}+\frac12z_{xy}+\frac14z_{yy}=0.
$$

所以

$$
w_{uu}=\frac12-Z_{uu}=\frac12.
$$

无需先把 $z_x,z_y,z_{xx},z_{xy},z_{yy}$ 全部用 $w$ 的导数展开。

（Ⅱ）对 $u$ 两次积分，并利用给定条件

由第一问，

$$
w_u=\frac u2+C_1(v).
$$

代入 $w_u(0,v)=ve^{-v}$，得 $C_1(v)=ve^{-v}$，于是

$$
w=\frac{u^2}{4}+uve^{-v}+C_2(v).
$$

再由 $w(0,v)=v^2/4$，得 $C_2(v)=v^2/4$。因此

$$
w=\frac{u^2+v^2}{4}+uve^{-v}.
$$

由 $z=xy-w$，代回 $u=x+y$、$v=x-y$，得到

$$
z(x,y)=xy-\frac{x^2+y^2}{2}
-(x^2-y^2)e^{-(x-y)}.
$$

检验时，在新变量下有 $Z=-v^2/2-uve^{-v}$，所以 $Z_{uu}=0$，满足原偏微分方程；两条给定条件也可直接代回验证。

-(x^2-y^2)e^{-(x-y)}.
$$

检验时，在新变量下有 $Z=-v^2/2-uve^{-v}$，所以 $Z_{uu}=0$，满足原偏微分方程；两条给定条件也可直接代回验证。

items.stem: 设 $ f(x, y) $ 有二阶连续偏导数, 满足 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) = f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) $, $ f(x, 2x) = x^2 $, $ f_x^{\prime}(x, 2x) = x $, 则 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___ $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
$ f(x,2x)=x^{2} $两端对x求导，得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x $，故 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $。
$ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)=x $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=1 $。
$ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。
由 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=f_{yx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x) $，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=0 $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。

items.stem: 设有二阶连续偏导数的函数 $ u = u(s, t) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial s^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial t^{2}} $ 以及 $ u(x, 2x) = x^{2} $, $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x, 2x) = 4x $. 求 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $ 和 $ u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $.
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ u(x,2x)=x^{2} $ 可得， $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x. $ 代入 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x $ ，解得 $ u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{2x-4x}{2}=-x. $
对 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x,u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=-x $ 两端同时关于 x 求导得
$$
 \begin{cases}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=4,\\u_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=-1.\end{cases} 
$$
 
由于 u 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $ u_{21}^{\prime\prime} = u_{12}^{\prime\prime} $。又由已知条件知 $ u_{22}^{\prime\prime} = -u_{11}^{\prime\prime} $，代入上式得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=4,\\ u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)-2u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=-1.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
解得 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{6}{5},u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{7}{5}. $

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = f(x \cos y, y g(x)) $，其中函数 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $ f_{12}''(1,0) = 1 $，函数 $ g(x) $ 可导，且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{x=1\atop y=0} $。
items.answer_explanation:
由链式法则，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left(x\cos y\right)}{\partial x}+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left[yg(x)\right]}{\partial x}\\&=\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right),\\\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left[\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\right]}{\partial y}\\&=-\sin yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+\cos y\left[f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)\right.\\&\left.\quad+f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]+g^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\\&\quad+yg^{\prime}(x)\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]\end{aligned} 
$$
 
由 $ g(x) $ 可导且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $ 知， $ g'(1) = 0 $。将 $ x = 1, y = 0, g(1) = 2, g'(1) = 0 $ 代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $，得
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{\substack{x=1\\ y=0}}=2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,0\right)=2. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ z = e^{xy} + f(x + y, xy) $， $ f(u, v) $ 有二阶连续偏导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} = $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y e^{xy}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+y\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=e^{xy}+xye^{xy}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+x\cdot\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+y\cdot\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}+x\cdot\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\right) 
$$
 
$$
 =e^{xy}+xye^{xy}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+(x+y)\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=1 $，又 $ g(x,y)=f(x^{2}+y^{2},xy) $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}= $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot y 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+2x\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot y\right)+y\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot y\right)\\&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=(x^{2}-y^{2})\left(4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\right)=x^{2}-y^{2}. 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=x^{2}+y^{2}-f(x+y,xy) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $。
items.answer_explanation:
由于函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(u,v)=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(u,v) $。分别计算 $ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x},\frac{\partial g}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2x-f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)-yf_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=2y-f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+yf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-y\big[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)\big]-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\\&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-(x+y)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xyf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right).\end{aligned} 
$$
代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4-\left(x-y\right)^{2}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+2f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right). 
$$

 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2x-f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)-yf_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=2y-f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+yf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-y\big[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)\big]-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\\&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-(x+y)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xyf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right).\end{aligned} 
$$
代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4-\left(x-y\right)^{2}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+2f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right). 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right) $，求 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
items.answer_explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{x}-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}\Big)-\\&\quad\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]\\&=-\frac{y^{2}}{x^{4}}f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{x^{2}}f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}f_{u}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=1+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]+\\&\quad\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)-\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=1+\frac{y}{x^{3}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2}{xy}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{x}{y^{3}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{u}^{\prime}+\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=-\frac{1}{x}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)+\\&\quad\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{y^{2}}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{x^{2}}{y^{4}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 故 
$$
 x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2xy. 
$$

items.stem: 设 $ f(u) = \ln u, u = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}} $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}} $.
items.answer_explanation:
由题可得， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x}&=\frac{1}{u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\cdot\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\\&=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\Big(\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\Big)=\frac{y^{2}+z^{2}-x^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}. 
$$
 由变量对称性，有 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{z^{2}+x^{2}-y^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}-z^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 故得 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{1}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}. $

items.stem: 若二元函数 $ f(x,y) $ 存在二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ f(x,y) = -f(y,x) $，则下列结论中，错误的是()
items.answer_explanation: 记 $ u = f(x, y) $, $ v = f(y, x) $, 则 $ u = -v $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}} $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x \partial y} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x \partial y} $. 分别计算 u, v 的一阶、二阶偏导数: $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right) $, $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=f_{2}^{\prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{22}^{\prime \prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(y,x) $. 于是， $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $， $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $。选项B和选项D正确。由于 $ f(x,y) $存在二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}''(x,y)=f_{21}''(x,y) $。选项C正确。由排除法可知，应选 A. 下面举例说明选项 A 错误: 例如， $ f(x,y)=x^{3}-y^{3} $ 满足题干要求，但 $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=6x,f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-6y,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)\neq f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $.

items.stem: 已知  $ z = f(u, v) $,  $ u = x + y $,  $ v = xy $, 且  $ f(u, v) $ 的二阶偏导数都连续. 求  $ \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x \partial y} $.
items.correct_answer: $\displaystyle f_{uu}+(x+y)f_{uv}+xyf_{vv}+f_v$，其中各偏导数均在 $(u,v)=(x+y,xy)$ 处取值。
items.answer_explanation:
由 $u=x+y$、$v=xy$，先对 $x$ 求偏导：

$$z_x=f_u+yf_v.$$

再对 $y$ 求偏导，注意 $u_y=1$、$v_y=x$：

$$
z_{xy}=(f_u)_y+(yf_v)_y=(f_{uu}+xf_{uv})+f_v+y(f_{vu}+xf_{vv})=f_{uu}+(x+y)f_{uv}+xyf_{vv}+f_v.
$$

因二阶偏导数连续，$f_{uv}=f_{vu}$；各偏导数均在 $(u,v)=(x+y,xy)$ 处取值。

items.stem:
设函数 $z=f(x,y)$ 在点 $(1,1)$ 处可微，且
$$
f(1,1)=1,
 
f_x(1,1)=2,
 
f_y(1,1)=3.
$$
令
$$
\varphi(x)=f\bigl(x,f(x,x)\bigr).
$$
求
$$
\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\bigl[\varphi(x)\bigr]^3\right|_{x=1}.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
令
$$
u(x)=f(x,x),
$$
则
$$
u'(x)=f_x(x,x)+f_y(x,x).
$$
又
$$
\varphi(x)=f(x,u(x)),
$$
由复合函数求导法则，
$$
\varphi'(x)
=f_x\bigl(x,u(x)\bigr)
 +f_y\bigl(x,u(x)\bigr)u'(x).
$$
由 $u(1)=f(1,1)=1$，可得
$$
\begin{aligned}
\varphi(1)&=f(1,u(1))=f(1,1)=1,\\
u'(1)&=f_x(1,1)+f_y(1,1)=2+3=5,\\
\varphi'(1)&=f_x(1,1)+f_y(1,1)u'(1)\\
&=2+3\times5=17.
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^3\right|_{x=1}
&=3[\varphi(1)]^2\varphi'(1)\\
&=3\times1^2\times17\\
&=51.
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
由复合函数求导法则，
$$
\varphi'(x)
=f_x\bigl(x,u(x)\bigr)
 +f_y\bigl(x,u(x)\bigr)u'(x).
$$
由 $u(1)=f(1,1)=1$，可得
$$
\begin{aligned}
\varphi(1)&=f(1,u(1))=f(1,1)=1,\\
u'(1)&=f_x(1,1)+f_y(1,1)=2+3=5,\\
\varphi'(1)&=f_x(1,1)+f_y(1,1)u'(1)\\
&=2+3\times5=17.
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^3\right|_{x=1}
&=3[\varphi(1)]^2\varphi'(1)\\
&=3\times1^2\times17\\
&=51.
\end{aligned}
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(0,1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(u,v) $ 的极值， $ z = f(2x + y, f(x,y)) $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,1)} $。
items.answer_explanation: 对 $ z = f(2x + y, f(x, y)) $ 两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2f_{1}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))+f_{2}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。继续对上式两端关于 $y$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)+\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\right]f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)$。由极值的必要条件可知 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $。将 $ f(0,1)=1,f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $ 代入上式可得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,1\right)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1,1\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(0,1\right)$.

items.stem: 已知函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(1, 1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(x, y) $ 的极值，且 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(1,1)} = (\quad) $.
items.answer_explanation: 由题，复合函数 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $ 的复合结构图（略）。$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot y+f_{2}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\{f_{11}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot x+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}y+f_{1}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]+\{f_{21}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]x+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)$。由于 $ f(1,1)=1 $ 是极值，故 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=0 $，于是 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=f^{\prime \prime}_{11}(1,1)=f^{\prime \prime}_{uu}(1,1)$.

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 可微，满足 $ \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} \right)^2 = 1 $， $ z(r, \theta) $ 为 $ f(x, y) $ 在极坐标系下的表示，则对单位圆周上的任一点 $ (1, \theta) $， $ \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} \right)^2 = $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
在极坐标系下，$ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial\theta}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-r\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}r\cos\theta. 
$$
当 $ r=1 $ 时，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial r}\right)^{2}&+\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta\right)^{2}+\left[\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cos\theta\right]^{2}\\&=\left(\cos^{2}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta\right)\left[\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}\right]\\&=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}=1.\end{aligned} 
$$

items.stem: 设可微函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ 在极坐标变换下满足 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} = r $，则 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0) + f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1) = $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
由极坐标变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} x &= r\cos\theta, \\ y &= r\sin\theta \end{aligned}\right. $ 和链式法则，可知
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=f_{x}^{\prime}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+f_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\cos\theta f_{x}^{\prime}+\sin\theta f_{y}^{\prime}=r. 
$$
上式两端同乘 $ r $，可得 $ xf_{x}^{\prime} + yf_{y}^{\prime} = r^{2} $。
分别代入 $ (x,y)=(1,0) $， $ (x,y)=(0,1) $，可得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)=1 $， $ f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=1 $。因此， $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)+f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=2 $。

items.stem: 设变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-2y,\\ v&=x+ay\end{aligned}\right. $ 可把方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ ，求常数 $ a $ 。（这里应假设 $ z $ 有二阶连续偏导数）
items.answer_explanation:
由变换 $ u = x - 2y $, $ v = x + ay $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + a\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。

 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。

设函数 $u=f(x,y)$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足
$$
4\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}
+12\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}
+5\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=0.
$$
确定常数 $a,b$ 的值，使上述等式在可逆线性变换
$$
\xi=x+ay,\qquad \eta=x+by\qquad(a\ne b)
$$
下简化为
$$
\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0.
$$
items.answer_explanation:
首先检查变量变换的可逆条件：
$$
\frac{\partial(\xi,\eta)}{\partial(x,y)}
=\begin{vmatrix}1&a\\1&b\end{vmatrix}
=b-a\ne0.
$$
因此应要求 $a\ne b$。

由复合函数求导法则，得
$$
u_x=u_\xi+u_\eta,\qquad
u_y=au_\xi+bu_\eta.
$$
继续求导，并利用混合偏导数相等，得
$$
\begin{aligned}
u_{xx}&=u_{\xi\xi}+2u_{\xi\eta}+u_{\eta\eta},\\
u_{xy}&=au_{\xi\xi}+(a+b)u_{\xi\eta}+bu_{\eta\eta},\\
u_{yy}&=a^2u_{\xi\xi}+2ab\,u_{\xi\eta}+b^2u_{\eta\eta}.
\end{aligned}
$$
代入原方程，得
$$
\begin{aligned}
&(4+12a+5a^2)u_{\xi\xi}\\
&\quad+[8+12(a+b)+10ab]u_{\xi\eta}\\
&\quad+(4+12b+5b^2)u_{\eta\eta}=0.
\end{aligned}
$$
要使其化为 $u_{\xi\eta}=0$，需令两个纯二阶偏导数的系数为零：
$$
\begin{cases}
5a^2+12a+4=0,\\
5b^2+12b+4=0.
\end{cases}
$$
因为
$$
5t^2+12t+4=(5t+2)(t+2),
$$
且 $a\ne b$，所以
$$
(a,b)=\left(-2,-\frac25\right)
\quad\text{或}\quad
(a,b)=\left(-\frac25,-2\right).
$$
此时 $a+b=-12/5$、$ab=4/5$，混合偏导数的系数为
$$
8+12(a+b)+10ab=-\frac{64}{5}\ne0.
$$
故原方程恰好化为
$$
-\frac{64}{5}u_{\xi\eta}=0,
$$
与所要求的方程等价。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，则下列各项中的变换能将方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ 的是（）
items.answer_explanation:
观察选项知，可设 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+by,\\ v&=cx+y.\end{aligned}\right. $ 将 u, v 看作中间变量，分别计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $。计算得： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+c\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+2c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial z^{2}}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(1+b c\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\;=\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;=\;b^{2}\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;+\;2b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
 代入原方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，可得 
$$
 \left(2+b-3b^{2}\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(4c+1+b c-6b\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+\left(2c^{2}+c-3\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由已知条件，该方程可化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{cases}2+b-3b^{2}=0,\\4c+1+bc-6b\neq0,\\2c^{2}+c-3=0.\end{cases} 
$$
 解得 b = 1 或 $ -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1 或 $ -\frac{3}{2} $。由此可排除选项 A、C、D。并且，选项 B 满足 $ b = -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1，且符合 $ 4c + 1 + bc - 6b \neq 0 $ 的要求。因此，应选 B.

items.stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 二阶偏导数连续，且 $ \begin{cases} u = x + ay, \\ v = x + by \end{cases} $（$a \lt b$）可将方程 $ 3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u \partial v} = 0, z(x, 0) = \sin x, z_{y}^{\prime}(x, 0) = 0. $ (1) 求 $a,b$ 的值；(2) 求 $ z(x,y) $ 的表达式.
items.answer_explanation:
由 $u=x+ay$，$v=x+by$ 得 $z_x=z_u+z_v$，$z_y=az_u+bz_v$。代入原方程后，$z_{uu}$ 与 $z_{vv}$ 的系数分别为 $a^2-4a+3$、$b^2-4b+3$。令二者为 $0$，并由 $a\lt b$ 得 $a=1,b=3$，此时方程化为 $z_{uv}=0$。故 $z=f(x+y)+g(x+3y)$。由 $z(x,0)=\sin x$ 得 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$；由 $z_y(x,0)=0$ 得 $f'(x)+3g'(x)=0$。再由 $f'(x)+g'(x)=\cos x$，解得 $f'(x)=\frac{3}{2}\cos x$，$g'(x)=-\frac{1}{2}\cos x$。积分并结合 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$，得 
$$
z=\frac{3}{2}\sin(x+y)-\frac{1}{2}\sin(x+3y).
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，作变量代换 $ \xi = x, \eta = y - x $，将方程 $ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0 $ 化为以 $ \xi, \eta $ 为自变量的方程。
items.answer_explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}. 
$$
 故 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0. 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。

document.stem_md: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
document.explanation_md:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。

items.stem: 设 $u(x,y)$ 有二阶连续偏导数，利用变换 $\xi=x+ay,\eta=x+by$，将方程 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ 化为 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值。
items.answer_explanation: 视 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量。由已知，得 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot1+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot1$，$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot a+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot b$。这里 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}$、$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}$ 是以 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量的二元函数，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+(a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。代入已知方程，得 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=(1+4a+3a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left[2+4(a+b)+6ab\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+(1+4b+3b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。又由已知，得 $\begin{cases}1+4a+3a^{2}=0,\\1+4b+3b^{2}=0,\\2+4(a+b)+6ab\neq0,\end{cases}$ 联立①、②式解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.$ 或 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-\frac{1}{3},\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right.$ 且都满足③式，故为所求。

items.answer_explanation:
记 $g=ax+by$。由 $u=ve^g$，分别对 $x,y$ 求偏导，得
$$
u_x=e^g(v_x+av),
$$
$$
u_{xx}=e^g(v_{xx}+2av_x+a^2v),
$$
$$
u_y=e^g(v_y+bv),
$$
$$
u_{yy}=e^g(v_{yy}+2bv_y+b^2v).
$$
代入原方程，并约去非零因子 $e^g$，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
&2v_{xx}-2v_{yy}\\
&\quad +(4a+3)v_x+(-4b+3)v_y\\
&\quad +(2a^2-2b^2+3a+3b)v=0.
\end{aligned}
$$
要消去一阶偏导数，须使 $v_x,v_y$ 的系数都为零，即
$$
4a+3=0,\qquad -4b+3=0.
$$
故
$$
a=-\frac34,\qquad b=\frac34.
$$
此时 $v$ 的系数也为零，原方程化为
$$
2v_{xx}-2v_{yy}=0.
$$

items.stem: 已知函数 $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-4\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0 $，求 $ a,b $ 的值，使得在变换 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)e^{ax+by} $ 下，上述等式可化为不含 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数的等式。
items.answer_explanation:
由 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot av=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot b v=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b v\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=a\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}+a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=b\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right). 
$$
代入已知等式可得，
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left[\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right)-2\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right)+3\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)-4\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)\right]=0. 
$$
整理上式，可得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+(2a+3)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-(4b+4)\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+(a^{2}v-2b^{2}v+3a v-4b v)=0. 
$$
要使得式中不含有 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数，需使 $ 2a+3=0,4b+4=0 $。解得 $ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
因此，$ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (z + y)^{x} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)} = $ ___
items.answer_explanation: 将方程 $ (z + y)^{x} = xy $ 化为 $ e^{x\ln(z + y)} = xy $。对所得方程两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数，可得 $ e^{x\ln(z+y)}\left[\ln(z+y)+\frac{x\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}}{z+y}\right]=y $。当 $x=1, y=2$ 时，由原方程可知 $z=0$，从而由上式可得 $ e^{\ln 2}\left(\ln 2+\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,2)}}{2}\right)=2 $，即 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}= 2(1-\ln 2) $。

document.explanation_md: 将方程 $ (z + y)^{x} = xy $ 化为 $ e^{x\ln(z + y)} = xy $。对所得方程两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数，可得 $ e^{x\ln(z+y)}\left[\ln(z+y)+\frac{x\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}}{z+y}\right]=y $。当 $x=1, y=2$ 时，由原方程可知 $z=0$，从而由上式可得 $ e^{\ln 2}\left(\ln 2+\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,2)}}{2}\right)=2 $，即 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}= 2(1-\ln 2) $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2, \frac{1}{2})} = $ ___
items.answer_explanation:
（法一）对已知方程两端关于 $x$ 求导，可得 $ \frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z-1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得， $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2}, z = 1 $ 代入上式可得， $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{2} $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4} $。
（法二）记 $ F(x,y,z) = \ln z + e^{z-1} - xy $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = -y $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = \frac{1}{z} + e^{z-1} $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得 $z=1$。根据隐函数存在定理， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}{F_{z}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}=-\frac{-\frac{1}{2}}{2}=\frac{1}{4} $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (x + 1)z + y \ln z - \arctan(2xy) = 1 $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = $ ___
items.answer_explanation:
将 $x=0, y=2$ 代入原方程得 $ z + 2 \ln z = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。
方法一：对原方程两边关于 $x$ 求偏导，得 $ z + (x + 1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \cdot \frac{1}{z} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{2y}{1 + 4x^2y^2} = 0 $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - 4 = 0 $，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = 1 $。
方法二：记 $ F(x,y,z)=(x+1)z+y\ln z-\arctan(2xy)-1 $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=z-\frac{2y}{1+4x^{2}y^{2}} $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=x+1+\frac{y}{z} $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=1-4=-3 $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=0+1+2=3 $。根据公式 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-3}{3}=1 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} \, dt = 0 $ 确定，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $
items.answer_explanation:
### 解析

**正确答案：A**

**方法一：利用隐函数求导公式**

设 $F(x, y, z) = z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t$。

分别对 $x, y, z$ 求偏导数：

$$
F_x = -\frac{\partial}{\partial x} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
F_y = -\frac{\partial}{\partial y} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -\left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = e^{-y^2}
$$

$$
F_z = 1 + \frac{1}{z} = \frac{z+1}{z}
$$

根据隐函数求导公式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{F_x}{F_z}$ 和 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{F_y}{F_z}$，可得：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{-e^{-x^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{e^{-y^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

将两式相加：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2} - \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

**方法二：两边直接对 $x$ 和 $y$ 求偏导**

方程两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（将 $y$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $x$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - e^{-x^2} = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = e^{-x^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

同理，方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（将 $x$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $y$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -e^{-y^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

两式相加即可得到最终结果：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = y \cos x + 2x $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,1)} = $ ___.
items.answer_explanation:
解法 1：对已知方程两端关于 $ x $ 求偏导数，可得 
$$
 \frac{1}{z+1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\mathrm{e}^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-y\sin x+2. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。令 $ f(z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - 1 $，则 $ f'(z) = \frac{1}{z + 1} + e^{z} $。当 $ z > -1 $ 时， $ f'(z) > 0 $， $ f(z) $ 单调增加。观察可得 $ f(0) = 0 $，结合 $ f(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ f(z) $ 的唯一零点，即 $ z = 0 $ 为方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $ 的唯一实根。将 $ x = 0, y = 1, z = 0 $ 代入上式可得 $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 2 $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 1 $。
解法 2：记 $ F(x, y, z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - y \cos x - 2x $，则 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=y\sin x-2,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{z+1}+e^{z}. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。同解法 1 得 $ z = 0 $。根据隐函数存在定理， 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}=-\frac{-2}{2}=1. 
$$

items.stem: 设隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ y + z = x f(y^{2} - z^{2}) $ 确定，$ f $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + z \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 等于
items.answer_explanation:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=y+z-xf(y^{2}-z^{2}) $，于是 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1-2xyf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf-z+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{xf-xf+y+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=y $。故应选(C)。
